items.originalTitle: Lewis Hamilton admits Red Bull achieved what he thought was impossible
detailZh: 刘易斯·汉密尔顿承认红牛车队实现了他认为不可能的事情
这位七届世界冠军承认，他低估了红牛车队的实力，因为车队在今年继续缩小差距
对于法拉利车迷来说，这里是最新的Scuderia 法拉利 F1新闻，车手更新，技术分析和来自马拉内洛及更远地方的赛事反应
刘易斯·汉密尔顿承认，他原本不相信红牛车队能制造出比梅赛德斯或法拉利更好的引擎。但车队与福特的合作制造出了国际汽联认定的基准内燃机后，汉密尔顿表示，车队‘证明了一切人的错误’
红牛的引擎今年首次亮相，马克斯·维斯塔潘已经在这套引擎的推动下赢得了巴林和新加坡大奖赛。
当被问及是否同意伊萨克·哈德贾的观点，即法拉利而不是红牛在新加坡拥有最快的赛车时，汉密尔顿对这位年轻车手表现得非常得体。
“首先，我认为伊萨克是一位了不起的车手。我们在这里有不同的看法。最终，他们做得非常出色。红牛已经做了很多年的出色工作。他们不断地让我感到惊讶，我在很多年前，当我年轻的时候，就举起了我的手。
“我想，他们不可能像拥有如此悠久历史的其他车队，比如拥有悠久历史的迈凯轮、法拉利那样做到这一点，但他们做到了，他们证明了我错了，而且他们在过去几年里一直保持着出色的成功。
“但是这个（引擎），我觉得没有人能够比得上梅赛德斯，比如，或者法拉利，他们凭借他们拥有的资源、经验和知识产权所能做到的更好的引擎。”
“然而，他们又一次证明了我们错了，所有人都错了，他们又造出了最好的引擎。”
“七届世界冠军补充说，红牛车队已经从今年年初的困难局面中恢复过来。”
“马克斯·维斯塔潘，红牛车队，伊萨克·哈吉亚，红牛车队”
“显然，他们有一个小小的颠簸开始，但就像你去年看到的那样，他们有一辆惊人的赛车，他们有伟大的车手，显然有伟大的领导力，我认为他们将非常非常难以...他们在所有弯道上的速度和我们一样快，这是我们一直以来的优势，所以他们现在在弯道上和我们持平，而且他们在直道上快了三到四十分之一。”
红牛决定在本田最初决定离开F1后建立自己的引擎，在米尔顿凯恩斯设立红牛动力系统，并将福特作为新规则下的合作伙伴引入。
他们的进步是以经验丰富的竞争对手为代价的。汉密尔顿的评论与迈凯轮的奥斯卡·皮亚斯特里的评论相呼应，皮亚斯特里在早些时候的练习中说红牛在过去几周成为了“最一致快速的车”。
红牛在 constructors’ championship 的第三名争夺战中落后于迈凯轮七分，维斯塔潘正在追逐连续第三场胜利。这位荷兰人在FP1中排在查尔斯·勒克莱尔之后，以第二快的速度结束。
detailEn: Lewis Hamilton admits Red Bull achieved what he thought was impossible
The seven-time world champion admits he underestimated Red Bull's capabilities as the team continues to close the gap this year
For Ferrari fans. The latest Scuderia Ferrari F1 news, driver updates, technical analysis and race reaction from Maranello and beyond.

Lewis Hamilton has admitted that he didn't believe Red Bull could ever build a better engine than Mercedes or Ferrari. But after the team's partnership with Ford built what the FIA has identified as the benchmark internal combustion engine, Hamilton says the team has "proved everybody wrong".
Red Bull's power unit made its debut this year and Max Verstappen has already won both the Bahrain and Singapore Grands Prix under its power.
Asked whether he agreed with Isack Hadjar's view that Ferrari, not Red Bull, had the fastest car in Singapore, Hamilton was diplomatic with the young driver.

“Well, firstly, I think Isack is an amazing driver. We’re going to have different opinions there. Ultimately, they’ve done an amazing job. Red Bull have done an amazing job for many, many years. They continuously surprise me, and I put my hand up many, many years ago when I was younger.

"I was like, there’s no way they’re going to be able to do what these other teams like McLaren with all that heritage, Ferrari with all that heritage, but they have, and they proved me wrong, and they’ve continued to have amazing success over the years.

"But this one is where the engine, I was like, there’s no way that anyone’s going to be able to build a better engine than what Mercedes, for example, or Ferrari are capable of doing with the resources they have and the experience they have and the IP.
"And yet again, they proved us wrong, everybody wrong again, and they built the best engine.”
The seven-time world champion added that Red Bull had recovered from a difficult start to the year.
Max Verstappen, Red Bull Racing, Isack Hadjar, Red Bull Racing

“Obviously, they had a little bit of a wobbly start, but like you saw last year, they’ve got an amazing car, they’ve got great drivers, clearly got great leadership, and I think they will be very, very hard to... they’re just as quick through all the corners as us in the last race, and that’s been our strength, so they’ve matched us now through the corners, and they’re three, four tenths quicker down the straights.”
Red Bull decided to build its own engines after Honda’s original decision to leave F1, setting up Red Bull Powertrains in Milton Keynes and bringing in Ford as a partner for the new regulations.

Its progress has come at the expense of rivals with far more experience of building F1 engines. Hamilton’s comments mirror those of McLaren’s Oscar Piastri, who said in an earlier session that Red Bull had become “the most consistently quick car” over the last few weeks.

Red Bull heads into the weekend seven points behind McLaren in the fight for third in the constructors’ championship, with Verstappen chasing a third straight win. The Dutchman finished second-fastest in FP1 behind Charles Leclerc.

keyPointsEn: Hamilton initially didn't believe Red Bull could surpass Mercedes or Ferrari in engine manufacturing

items.titleZh: 纽维谈本田2026年进步令人失望及2027年前景
items.summaryZh: 阿斯顿·马丁车队领队阿德里安·纽维在奥斯汀的FIA新闻发布会上表示，本田对2026年的进步幅度可能略感失望，但强调这只会坚定双方继续前进的决心。
items.originalTitle: Newey on Honda progress 'disappointment' and signs for 2027
items.summaryEn: Aston Martin team principal Adrian Newey said at the FIA press conference in Austin that Honda have probably been a little disappointed with their progress in 2026, but stressed this only strengthens their resolve to move forward.
detailZh: 在F1赛季初向媒体抛出一些关于本田的重磅言论后，阿斯顿·马丁车队领队阿德里安·纽维在周五奥斯汀的FIA新闻发布会上表现得更为谨慎。
尽管全程用词明显谨慎，纽维还是透露了足够的信息，既谈到本田2026年进展的“失望”，也谈到对明年的“希望”。
本田的ADUO升级——包括已引入的内燃机和涡轮改进——未能帮助阿斯顿·马丁稳定争夺积分，但一段时间以来外界也一直在谈论重心将放在2027年取得更大进展上。
不过纽维并不否认，从墨尔本揭幕战时那种糟糕的谷底来看，取得的进步或许没有他或本田希望的那么多。
当被 The Race 问及事情是否如本田所预期的那样取得进展时，纽维带着一丝苦笑，停顿了一下后说道：“我认为可以公平地说，本田可能对今年所取得的进展感到有些失望。”
“但一如既往，或者说在这种情况下经常发生的是，这只会坚定未来前进的决心。未来显然对两家公司都很重要。”
“他们非常坚定。这些事情不会一夜之间改变，但他们有很多优秀的人才，现在有很多良好的流程已经到位。”
纽维本可以轻易地将阿斯顿·马丁在赛季现阶段仍处境艰难的责任归咎于本田，但他显然急于不想搅乱局面。
相反，他表示已有数据可以用来找出阿斯顿·马丁-本田组合的弱点所在。
“就底盘和引擎之间的相对差距而言……这大概不该由我来说，”他说。“我认为如果人们查看数据，就能从中开始得到更清晰的图景。”
但在告诉人们去哪里寻找当前发生的情况的同时，他也谈到了对未来的希望。
“本田显然在努力工作，”他说。“众所周知，他们是一家伟大的公司，能够成就伟业，过去已多次证明这一点。我们正与他们紧密合作，因此对未来抱有希望。”
本田看起来将在明年对其动力单元设计进行改造，这是规则调整的一部分，涉及燃油流量提高和增压压力提升。
纽维确实暗示了本田位于日本樱花的基地在2027年筹备方面取得的进展。
他说：“现在有很多能量和项目正在推进，这些或许还处于开发的早期阶段，但我们从中看到了很大的希望。”
“现在要评论动力单元在赛季初究竟会处于什么水平还为时过早，也无法判断届时——假设动力单元咨询委员会（PUAC）允许——是否会在第一段赛程结束时的第八场比赛前有进一步的开发。”
后一条评论表明，更多额外开发与升级机会步骤即将到来，本田今年巨大的差距使得2027年无论下赛季开局表现如何，都能获得两次额外的认证升级机会。
detailEn: After dropping some Honda bombshells in front of the media at the start of the Formula 1 season, Aston Martin team principal Adrian Newey was more on message when he appeared in Friday's FIA press conference at Austin.
But despite a clearly cautious choice of words throughout, Newey gave enough away about both the 'disappointment' of Honda's 2026 progress and the "hope" of what's to come next year.

Honda's ADUO updates - both the internal combustion engine and turbo steps that have been introduced - have fallen short of being able to help Aston Martin fight regularly for points, but equally talk for a while now has been about the focus being on bigger progress in 2027.
There was no denying from Newey though that, from the depths of how bad things were back at the season opener in Melbourne, steps forward had perhaps not been as much as he nor Honda wanted.

Asked by The Race about if things had moved forward as much as Honda had anticipated, Newey - with a wry smile, and after a pause - said: "I think it's fair to say that Honda have probably been a little bit disappointed with how much progress they have managed to make this year.
"But as always, or as is so often the case in that situation, it only strengthens resolve to go forward in the future. The future is obviously the important bit for both companies.
"They are very determined. These things don't change overnight, but they have a lot of good people, a lot of good processes now in place."
Newey could easily have pointed the finger at Honda over the fact things remain difficult for Aston Martin at this stage of the campaign, but he was clearly eager not to rock the boat.
Instead, he said the data was available to work out where the weakness was in the Aston Martin-Honda package.

"[In terms of] relative deficit between chassis and engine...it's probably not for me to say," he said. "I think if people look at the GPS [data], then you can start to get a much better picture from that."
But while telling people where to look for what was happening now, he talked of hope for the future.

"Honda obviously are working hard," he said. "They're a great company, as we all know, capable of great things, as they've proved many times in the past. We are working closely with them, and so [are] hopeful of the future."
Honda looks set to revamp its power unit design for next year as part of a reshuffle of the rules that involves the fuel-flow rate increasing and boost pressure being lifted.
Newey certainly hinted at progress coming out of Honda's Sakura base in Japan about what was being lined up for 2027.
"There's a lot of energy and projects on the way now that perhaps are in their early stages of development, but we see a lot of promise from those," he said.

"It's too early to comment on exactly where the power unit will be at the start of the season and whether then, assuming it's allowed under the PUAC [Power Unit Advisory Committee], there will be a further development for what will be race eight at the end of the first period.”

That latter comment suggests more ADUO steps are in the offing, with Honda's large deficit this year allowing two further homologation upgrade opportunities in 2027 irrespective of how well it starts next season.
keyPointsZh: 本田引入的内燃机与涡轮ADUO升级未能帮助阿斯顿·马丁稳定争夺积分
纽维承认，相比墨尔本揭幕战时的糟糕状况，今年的进步幅度或许未达他和本田的期望
keyPointsEn: Honda's ADUO updates to the internal combustion engine and turbo have fallen short of helping Aston Martin fight regularly for points.
Newey acknowledged that the steps forward from the low point in Melbourne may not have been as much as he or Honda wanted.
